Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class OAuth2ClientConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver.OAuth2ClientConfiguration
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties({ResourceServerProperties.class,ServiceClientAuthProperties.class,ServiceClientKeyProperties.class}) public class OAuth2ClientConfiguration extends Object
The OAuth2 client of the service client: its registrations, the authorized client manager that caches the access tokens and renews them shortly before they expire, and the documents client that sends them. Nothing here depends on a profile: every setting has a default, and a mutual TLS or private_key_jwt setup only fails when its key or bundle is missing at the moment it is needed.

    • serviceClientAuthorizedClientManager

      @Bean org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager serviceClientAuthorizedClientManager(org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository registrations, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.OAuth2AuthorizedClientService clients, TokenEndpointClients tokenClients, PrincipalMapper principalMapper, ServiceClientAuthProperties properties)
      The authorized client manager. It works without a servlet request, as there is none in the CLI. A cached token is renewed once less than service-client.auth.refresh-before of its life is left.
      Parameters:
      registrations - the registrations.
      clients - the cache of the authorized clients.
      tokenClients - the clients of the token endpoint.
      principalMapper - builds the principal of the service client.
      properties - settings of the service client.
      Returns:
      the manager.
